description.value: Buddha-Full Northwoods Village is a 100% vegan, organic, and gluten-free cafe, juice bar, and provisions store situated in Northwoods Village on Dollarton Highway in North Vancouver. One of two Buddha-Full locations in the region, it offers cold-pressed juices, smoothies, entrees, and salads alongside a retail shop stocked with provisions. The ethos-driven brand emphasizes community values and clean plant-based eating, making it a distinctive fuel stop for cyclists seeking organic, allergen-conscious food.
